response.justification: This candidate is a full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no evident background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD design, or deep-learning workload optimization, which are core to this Principal Performance Architect role focused on hardware and cloud infrastructure for AI accelerators.
strengths: Strong full-stack and low-latency systems experience (e.g., DLang async I/O work at Sociomantic)
Deep, long-tenured professional track record (15+ years) meeting seniority/experience thresholds
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture design
No exposure to AI accelerator hardware, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD systems
No evidence of deep-learning workload performance analysis or hardware-software co-design

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
